entries.task_title: Pre-Proposer Suppression of Plateaued AST Refactors
entries.title: Pre-Proposer Suppression of Plateaued AST Refactors
entries.hypothesis: Suppressing repetitive static AST and CLI-argument modification tasks on targets with multiple recent inconclusive or skipped executor verdicts will reduce the wasted attempt rate below 0.08 without lowering successful integration throughput.
entries.action: Add an existence/failure-signature gate in nanobot/runtime/demand.py that temporarily de-prioritizes AST/CLI refactor demands on targets exhibiting >=2 consecutive inconclusive/skipped outcomes.
entries.data_to_collect: scorecard.loop.wasted_attempt_rate, inconclusive/skipped cycle counts, and tokens_per_integration over 20 cycles.
entries.insight_criterion: Confirmed if wasted_attempt_rate drops below 0.08 and repeat_failure_rate drops below 0.04; refuted if net accepted integrations per 24h decreases by >20%.
entries.evidence: scorecard.loop.wasted_attempt_rate, inconclusive/skipped cycle counts, and tokens_per_integration over 20 cycles.

entries.task_title: exercise-unconfirmed-scripts-via-test-harness
entries.title: exercise-unconfirmed-scripts-via-test-harness
entries.hypothesis: Focusing test-expansion cycles on invoking CLI entrypoints of unconfirmed scripts in scripts/ (generating runtime bytecode and confirm_serves traces) rather than isolated test assertions will increase loop.confirmed_integrations by at least 5 without inflating completed_declared or worsening repeat failures.
entries.action: Bias proposer demand selection towards integration tests that execute unconfirmed script surfaces from docs/SYSTEM_MAP.md via subprocess or import execution.
entries.data_to_collect: loop.confirmed_integrations, value.completed_declared, value.confirmed_ratio, and loop.wasted_attempt_rate across the next 15 cycles.
entries.insight_criterion: Confirmed if loop.confirmed_integrations increases by >= 5 and value.confirmed_ratio exceeds 0.46; refuted if completed_declared continues to grow faster than confirmed integrations or loop.repeat_failure_rate exceeds 0.075.
entries.evidence: loop.confirmed_integrations, value.completed_declared, value.confirmed_ratio, and loop.wasted_attempt_rate across the next 15 cycles.

entries.task_title: suppress-in-tree-proposals-for-host-metrics-staleness
entries.title: suppress-in-tree-proposals-for-host-metrics-staleness
entries.hypothesis: Classifying host_metrics staleness as an external systemd timer/telemetry interval condition rather than an in-tree code defect will reduce wasted proposer attempts on goal-gap-a820ca0c8bb3 to zero without degrading fresh feed counts.
entries.action: Mark goal-gap-a820ca0c8bb3 as in-tree futile for standard code-bearing edits and verify whether host_metrics refreshes on its next host service timer tick.
entries.data_to_collect: Proposals dispatched against goal-gap-a820ca0c8bb3, age_seconds of host_metrics feed over 24 hours, and loop.wasted_attempts.
entries.insight_criterion: Confirmed if zero wasted cycle proposals target host_metrics while the feed alternates according to timer mtime; refuted if in-tree code changes are proven necessary to restore telemetry collection.
entries.evidence: Proposals dispatched against goal-gap-a820ca0c8bb3, age_seconds of host_metrics feed over 24 hours, and loop.wasted_attempts.

entries.task_title: Pre-filtering exhausted demand IDs in candidate selection resolves proposer starvation
entries.title: Pre-filtering exhausted demand IDs in candidate selection resolves proposer starvation
entries.hypothesis: Sequentially polling exhausted demands causes repeated proposer skips and starves executable proposals; filtering out exhausted demand IDs at candidate collection time will reduce consecutive skip bursts without degrading deduplication safety.
entries.action: Add an active demand exclusion filter in candidate collection within the proposer pipeline for demand IDs that have reached dedup exhaustion in the current window.
entries.data_to_collect: Proposer skip count, cycleish row progression, and consecutive dedup_exhausted occurrences across the next 30 cycles.
entries.insight_criterion: Confirmed if consecutive proposer_skip events drop by >= 50% without increasing the repeat_failure_rate above 0.070; refuted if wasted attempt rate increases or valid novel demands are prematurely dropped.
entries.evidence:
Proposer skip count, cycleish row progression, and consecutive dedup_exhausted occurrences across the next 30 cycles.
loop.proposer_rejects, loop.wasted_attempts, loop.repeat_failures, cost.calls_per_integration, and loop.confirmed_integrations over the 25 cycles.

entries.task_title: Turn-bounded direct-edit gate dissolves inspection-versus-completion budget trade-off
entries.title: Turn-bounded direct-edit gate dissolves inspection-versus-completion budget trade-off
entries.hypothesis: Subagents fail with partial outcomes (0 files changed) because tool-call budgets are exhausted during inspection harnesses; enforcing a target-file edit requirement before turn 5 will convert partial cycles into code-bearing integrations without lowering clean compilation ratio.
entries.action: Inject a directive check in the subagent bridge prompt requiring an initial patch/edit application to target_path within the first 4 turns.
entries.data_to_collect: Outcome distribution (partial vs success), confirmed_integration_ratio, and files_changed count per completed cycle over 20 cycles.
entries.insight_criterion: Confirmed if partial outcomes with 0 files changed decrease by >= 40% and confirmed_integration_ratio reaches >= 0.70; refuted if compile_failing count exceeds 0.
entries.evidence: Outcome distribution (partial vs success), confirmed_integration_ratio, and files_changed count per completed cycle over 20 cycles.

entries.task_title: Inject recent git commit subjects into proposer context to dissolve self-dedup rejects
entries.title: Inject recent git commit subjects into proposer context to dissolve self-dedup rejects
entries.hypothesis: Proposer rejects (50) and duplicate proposals (58) for repeat-failure CLI tools stem from the proposer LLM lacking recent commit subject history during prompt assembly. Providing recent git commit subjects for the target surface directly in the proposer prompt will reduce proposer self-dedup rejections by at least 40% without increasing cycle token overhead.
entries.action: Update proposer context assembly to inject the last 15 git commit subject lines touching the candidate target file prior to calling the LLM proposer.
entries.data_to_collect: Count of proposer_rejects with reason 'self_dedup' over the next 50 cycles, and proposer prompt token count delta.
entries.insight_criterion: Confirmed if self_dedup proposer rejects drop by >=40% over 50 cycles with <5% increase in proposer prompt tokens; refuted if reject rate remains above 8% of total proposals.
entries.evidence: Count of proposer_rejects with reason 'self_dedup' over the next 50 cycles, and proposer prompt token count delta.

entries.task_title: Pre-seed standard library module cache to dissolve search turn-burn in subagent runs
entries.title: Pre-seed standard library module cache to dissolve search turn-burn in subagent runs
entries.hypothesis: Subagents burn tool turns and time limits running dynamic inspection or redundant greps on absent stdlib/feature symbols (LESS-20260904-260bd269, LESS-20260904-d44ed220), driving repeat failures (rate 0.084) and wasted attempts (0.1126). Supplying sys.stdlib_module_names and strict single-grep absence rules in subagent system instructions will lower wasted attempt rate below 0.08.
entries.action: Add an explicit runtime hint in subagent execution prompts specifying sys.stdlib_module_names lookup and single-sweep search termination rules.
entries.data_to_collect: loop.wasted_attempt_rate, loop.repeat_failure_rate, and cost.calls_per_integration over the next 7-day window.
entries.insight_criterion: Confirmed if loop.wasted_attempt_rate decreases to <=0.08 and calls_per_integration decreases by >=10%; refuted if wasted_attempt_rate stays >=0.10.
entries.evidence: loop.wasted_attempt_rate, loop.repeat_failure_rate, and cost.calls_per_integration over the next 7-day window.

entries.task_title: Dynamic skill catalogue compaction to prevent system prompt overflow
entries.title: Dynamic skill catalogue compaction to prevent system prompt overflow
entries.hypothesis: Filtering and compacting skills_catalogue injection when estimated prompt size approaches the 24,000 character cap will eliminate system_prompt_overflow failures without degrading tool execution accuracy.
entries.action: Implement dynamic skill descriptor truncation or targeted skill selection in the prompt builder when system prompt sections exceed 20,000 total characters, evaluating over a 20-cycle window.
entries.data_to_collect: System prompt character lengths, frequency of system_prompt_overflow exit status 4 events, wasted_attempt_rate, and executor completion rate.
entries.insight_criterion: Confirmed if system_prompt_overflow occurrences drop to 0 and wasted_attempt_rate declines from 0.2073 to under 0.15; refuted if executor tool-misuse failure rate rises by more than 5%.
entries.evidence: System prompt character lengths, frequency of system_prompt_overflow exit status 4 events, wasted_attempt_rate, and executor completion rate.

entries.task_title: Pre-proposer futile surface pruning to dissolve proposal rejection churn
entries.title: Pre-proposer futile surface pruning to dissolve proposal rejection churn
entries.hypothesis: Enforcing deterministic surface-level exclusion of registered futile gaps (such as host_metrics/purge_stale_feeds) at the demand selection stage prior to LLM proposer invocation will eliminate futile-surface proposer rejections and reduce tokens per integration.
entries.action: Add an upstream check in the demand queue scheduler to filter out candidate demands mapping to active futile surfaces before formatting proposer prompts.
entries.data_to_collect: Proposer reject counts categorized by futile_surface, tokens_per_integration, and proposer call-to-integration conversion ratio over 30 cycles.
entries.insight_criterion: Confirmed if futile_surface proposer rejections drop to 0 and tokens_per_integration decreases by at least 5%; refuted if unblocked non-futile demands show a decrease in proposal generation rate.
entries.evidence: Proposer reject counts categorized by futile_surface, tokens_per_integration, and proposer call-to-integration conversion ratio over 30 cycles.

entries.task_title: Demand failure backoff to dissolve wasted attempt and repeat failure contradiction
entries.title: Demand failure backoff to dissolve wasted attempt and repeat failure contradiction
entries.hypothesis: Enforcing a 3-attempt backoff cooldown on repeat failing demand IDs in nanobot/runtime/demand.py will dissolve the contradiction between proposal volume (502 proposals) and cycle waste, reducing loop.wasted_attempt_rate from 0.3419 to <= 0.2200 and loop.repeat_failure_rate from 0.1573 to <= 0.1000 over 25 cycles without decreasing confirmed_integrations per day below 12.
entries.action: Implement a 48-hour backoff filter in nanobot/runtime/demand.py that suppresses re-queuing any demand ID with >= 3 unconfirmed attempts unless new diagnostic context or a code mutation is detected.
entries.data_to_collect: loop.wasted_attempt_rate, loop.repeat_failure_rate, loop.wasted_attempts, skips_by_reason.recent_duplicate_failure, and daily confirmed integrations.
entries.insight_criterion: Confirmed if loop.wasted_attempt_rate drops below 0.2500 and repeat_failures drop below 75 while confirmed integrations remain >= 10/day; refuted if wasted_attempt_rate remains >= 0.3000 after 25 cycles.
entries.evidence: loop.wasted_attempt_rate, loop.repeat_failure_rate, loop.wasted_attempts, skips_by_reason.recent_duplicate_failure, and daily confirmed integrations.

entries.task_title: Tech-tree saturation bypass for zero-gap active nodes
entries.title: Tech-tree saturation bypass for zero-gap active nodes
entries.hypothesis: Bypassing tech-tree nodes whose lever metric has zero room for gain (heldout-robustness at heldout_gap: 0.0) and un-plateauing proposer-quality when repeat_failure_rate > 0.12 will redirect cycle effort from zero-return tasks to proposal quality, reducing cost.tokens_per_integration from 1,212,722 to <= 1,050,000 within 20 cycles.
entries.action: Add a gate in the tech tree router that marks a node as saturated when its lever metric equals optimal (heldout_gap == 0.0) and automatically resets plateau status on proposer-quality when repeat_failure_rate exceeds the 0.10 baseline.
entries.data_to_collect: tech_tree.current, cost.tokens_per_integration, cost.calls_per_integration, and gain on proposer-quality.
entries.insight_criterion: Confirmed if tech tree transitions away from heldout-robustness and cost.tokens_per_integration drops below 1,100,000; refuted if tech tree remains on heldout-robustness or tokens_per_integration stays above 1,200,000.
entries.evidence: tech_tree.current, cost.tokens_per_integration, cost.calls_per_integration, and gain on proposer-quality.

entries.task_title: Orphaned hypothesis pruning to eliminate claim collisions and prompt bloat
entries.title: Orphaned hypothesis pruning to eliminate claim collisions and prompt bloat
entries.hypothesis: Retiring the 108 orphaned hypotheses and enforcing strict ID-keying will dissolve the state clutter contradiction where tracking active hypotheses generates claim collisions (10) and prompt overhead, dropping claim_collisions to 0 and reducing coordinator cycle token usage by >= 10% without degrading knowledge_lift.net_benefit.
entries.action: Execute a bounded cleanup sweep in the hypothesis manager to transition all hypotheses marked orphaned or inactive for >7 days to inconclusive_archived and enforce unique canonical ID lookups.
entries.data_to_collect: hypothesis_loop.orphaned, hypothesis_loop.claim_collisions, hypothesis_loop.active, and coordinator cycle token consumption.
entries.insight_criterion: Confirmed if hypothesis_loop.orphaned falls below 10 and hypothesis_loop.claim_collisions reaches 0 with no regression in knowledge_lift.net_benefit; refuted if claim collisions persist > 0 after the cleanup sweep.
entries.evidence: hypothesis_loop.orphaned, hypothesis_loop.claim_collisions, hypothesis_loop.active, and coordinator cycle token consumption.

entries.task_title: Futile-surface filtering in fallback proposal selection
entries.title: Futile-surface filtering in fallback proposal selection
entries.hypothesis: Filtering fallback proposal candidates against active futile surfaces before dispatch will eliminate auto-rejected fallback cycles targeting stale feed scripts, reducing wasted_attempt_rate from 0.4064 to below 0.25 within 24 hours without diminishing confirmed integrations.
entries.action: In nanobot/runtime/llm_proposer.py fallback proposal generation, add a preflight blacklist check against futile_gap_ids and their associated surface paths (e.g. scripts/purge_stale_feeds.py) to select an unblocked backlog task instead of a futile target.
entries.data_to_collect: loop.proposer_rejects, loop.wasted_attempts, loop.wasted_attempt_rate, and fallback rejection reasons in recent_cycles across 40 consecutive cycles.
entries.insight_criterion: Confirmed if proposer_rejects on fallback cycles drop to zero and wasted_attempt_rate declines by >= 10 percentage points over 24 hours; refuted if fallback rejections continue or skipping futile fallbacks causes loop.idle_share to rise above 0.05.
entries.evidence: loop.proposer_rejects, loop.wasted_attempts, loop.wasted_attempt_rate, and fallback rejection reasons in recent_cycles across 40 consecutive cycles.

entries.task_title: Demand retry cooldown on consecutive proposer skips and duplicate failures
entries.title: Demand retry cooldown on consecutive proposer skips and duplicate failures
entries.hypothesis: Applying a 3-cycle scheduling cooldown to demands that produce proposer_skips or duplicate failure skips will dissolve repeated selector churn on unresolvable defects, reducing repeat_failure_rate from 0.1616 to under 0.12 while raising confirmed_integration_ratio above 0.72.
entries.action: In nanobot/runtime/demand.py, introduce an exponential backoff cooldown counter for demand IDs that fail deduplication or trigger environmental proposer skips, yielding priority to actionable backlog demands.
entries.data_to_collect: loop.repeat_failures, loop.repeat_failure_rate, loop.skips_by_reason.recent_duplicate_failure, and distinct demand_ids integrated per 50 cycles.
entries.insight_criterion: Confirmed if repeat_failure_rate drops below 0.12 within 48 hours without decreasing the 24-hour total integration count; refuted if cooldown results in demand queue starvation or increased cycleish_rows.
entries.evidence: loop.repeat_failures, loop.repeat_failure_rate, loop.skips_by_reason.recent_duplicate_failure, and distinct demand_ids integrated per 50 cycles.

entries.task_title: Dynamic prompt catalogue pruning for doc-only and metadata proposals
entries.title: Dynamic prompt catalogue pruning for doc-only and metadata proposals
entries.hypothesis: Omitting the 8.7k character active skills catalogue from the system prompt on tasks classified as doc-only or memory updates will decrease tokens_per_integration by >= 15% (from 1.28M to <1.10M tokens) without degrading compile_clean_ratio or gate acceptance.
entries.action: In nanobot/runtime prompt assembly, detect when the targeted path lies entirely within docs/ or memory/ and strip out execution skill syntax templates to fit within a bounded ~14k character envelope.
entries.data_to_collect: cost.tokens_per_integration, prompt character count distributions for doc-tier cycles, and gate pass rates on doc changes over 25 cycles.
entries.insight_criterion: Confirmed if mean tokens_per_integration falls by >= 150,000 tokens over 48 hours with compile_clean_ratio remaining 1.0; refuted if stripped prompts trigger structural gate or format failures.
entries.evidence: cost.tokens_per_integration, prompt character count distributions for doc-tier cycles, and gate pass rates on doc changes over 25 cycles.

entries.task_title: Compact memory indexing to resolve prompt cap eviction and repeat failures
entries.title: Compact memory indexing to resolve prompt cap eviction and repeat failures
entries.hypothesis: The system's effort to preserve behavioral memory has pushed prompt occupancy to 23,504 / 24,000 characters, forcing arbitrary eviction of 28 memory index entries (4,695 chars dropped); condensing index entry summaries will fit all resident memories under the 24k ceiling and drop repeat failure rate below 0.13.
entries.action: Implement a character-budgeted summary compaction in the memory index compiler that truncates or condenses long index entries so total resident memory remains under 3,000 chars without dropping entries.
entries.data_to_collect: system_prompt.memory_index.dropped_entries, system_prompt.chars, loop.repeat_failure_rate, loop.repeat_failures across 10 consecutive cycles.
entries.insight_criterion: Confirmed if dropped_entries decreases from 28 to 0 and loop.repeat_failure_rate falls from 0.157 to <= 0.130. Refuted if memory entries continue to be dropped or repeat failure rate does not decrease.
entries.evidence: system_prompt.memory_index.dropped_entries, system_prompt.chars, loop.repeat_failure_rate, loop.repeat_failures across 10 consecutive cycles.

entries.task_title: Upstream futile surface pre-filtering in fallback target proposer
entries.title: Upstream futile surface pre-filtering in fallback target proposer
entries.hypothesis: Expanding fallback candidate paths to overcome primary stalled demands inadvertently generated 76 futile surface rejections (out of 93 total fallback rejects); pre-filtering candidate paths against the known futile surface index before prompt construction will eliminate futile surface rejects and drop wasted attempt rate below 0.42.
entries.action: Add an upstream set-membership check in the fallback proposer against the recorded futile surfaces register, skipping unviable target paths before generating LLM proposal requests.
entries.data_to_collect: loop.fallback_rejects_by_reason.futile_surface, loop.fallback_rejects, loop.wasted_attempt_rate, cost.calls_per_integration over 10 fallback events.
entries.insight_criterion: Confirmed if fallback_rejects_by_reason.futile_surface increases by 0 across 5 consecutive fallback cycles and loop.wasted_attempt_rate decreases from 0.4757 to <= 0.42. Refuted if futile surface rejections continue to rise.
entries.evidence: loop.fallback_rejects_by_reason.futile_surface, loop.fallback_rejects, loop.wasted_attempt_rate, cost.calls_per_integration over 10 fallback events.

entries.task_title: Futile-Surface Masking in Fallback Path Selection
entries.title: Futile-Surface Masking in Fallback Path Selection
entries.hypothesis: Masking target paths with recorded futile_surface rejections at the fallback target selection stage will dissolve the contradiction between expanding fallback search and accumulating futile attempts, raising fallback success rate above 60%.
entries.action: Constrain the fallback path generator to exclude target paths with >= 2 consecutive futile_surface rejections recorded in scorecard fallback_rejects for the next 15 fallback evaluations.
entries.data_to_collect: loop.fallback_rejects_by_reason.futile_surface, loop.fallback_success_rate, loop.fallback_cycles, and loop.fallback_successes.
entries.insight_criterion: Confirmed if new futile_surface rejects drop to 0 and fallback_success_rate rises to >= 0.60 across the test window; refuted if fallback cycle generation starves to 0 available paths or fallback_successes drop below baseline (0.43).
entries.evidence: loop.fallback_rejects_by_reason.futile_surface, loop.fallback_success_rate, loop.fallback_cycles, and loop.fallback_successes.

entries.task_title: Upstream fallback path filtering to eliminate self-dedup token waste
entries.title: Upstream fallback path filtering to eliminate self-dedup token waste
entries.hypothesis: Filtering candidate target paths against the recent failure and existence cache before invoking the fallback LLM proposer will reduce fallback self-dedup rejects by >=50% and decrease cost.tokens_per_integration without diminishing fallback success count.
entries.action: Add an upstream pre-dispatch filter in the fallback cycle generator that prunes any target path already recorded in skips_by_reason or fallback_rejects within the trailing 24 hours prior to generating proposals.
entries.data_to_collect: loop.fallback_rejects_by_reason.self_dedup, loop.fallback_successes, cost.tokens_per_integration, loop.wasted_attempts over the next 48 hours.

entries.evidence: loop.fallback_rejects_by_reason.self_dedup, loop.fallback_successes, cost.tokens_per_integration, loop.wasted_attempts over the next 48 hours.

entries.title: Quarantine high-churn repeat defects to reduce repeat failure rate
entries.hypothesis: Applying exponential cooldown to demand items that accumulate >=3 proposal rejections without integration will lower repeat_failure_rate below 0.14 and wasted_attempt_rate below 0.45 without depressing confirmed_integrations.
entries.action: Introduce a temporary 48-hour quarantine state in the demand prioritizer for demand IDs exceeding 3 proposals with <20% integration yield (e.g., defect-2da50639c3c6 and defect-9742233ecbf1).
entries.data_to_collect: loop.repeat_failure_rate, loop.wasted_attempt_rate, loop.confirmed_integrations, and funnel proposal counts for quarantined demand IDs.
